title: Animation Finally Gets Its Own Green Certification
summary: CineRegio, Ecoprod and Green Film's ANiMPACT pilot gives animation studios a path to funding tied to sustainability — something live action has had for years.

title: The “Plot” Against President Trump?
summary: No, not the one to supposedly steal an election — the one by ABC and NBC to keep his "big news" primetime address off their airwaves

summary: The eight-episode drama from creator Chloe Stearns — set amid the glamour of a luxury ski town — stars Rufus Sewell, Frances O'Connor, Alycia Debnam-Carey and Te Kohe Tuhaka.

title: The NBA Wants to Set Next Season’s TV Schedule, But It’s Waiting On LeBron
summary: NBA Commissioner Adam Silver said that the league does not want to schedule next season's games until it knows where the (now former) Lakers star lands.

title: Netflix Is Not Launching a FAST Offering … Yet
summary: "Free is something that we're going to continue to consider, but we have no near-term plans to launch something," said Netflix Co-CEO Greg Peters.

title: NBC, ABC and CNN Won’t Carry Trump Primetime Election Speech
summary: The broadcasters will stream the address and break in if needed, with other networks still scrambling to determine their plans for the speech. CBS, however, will air a special report at 9 p.m.
